text:
maya: quick thought while reviewing the compact regression diff mock: what if we surface an ultra-compact summary line per test that shows pass/fail, weight, and a tiny flaky badge? e.g. "✔ currency-format · w1.5 · flaky" so reviewers can triage at glance.
sam: i like that. helps reviewers who scan lots of tests. how do we compute flaky? recent N runs variance?
maya: yes, flaky = failed in >=2 of last 5 runs. backend can supply a flag. ui should show a tooltip "flaky: failed 3/5 recent runs".
noah: UX caution: small badges can be missed by screen readers. make sure the summary includes text that a11y users can parse and a descriptive aria-label on the whole collapsed row.
ara: concordant. aria-label suggestion: "currency-format, failing, weight 1.5, flaky (failed 3 of last 5)". also contrast: the tiny badge must not rely on green/red alone. add an outline or pattern.
karin: copy nit: "muted" vs "ignored" — product teams have different mental models. i prefer "ignored" in the compact view because "mute" sounds temporary/silent.
sam: hmm we already use "mute test" elsewhere, but mixing terms will confuse. pick one across the app. agree to standardize on "mute (ignore from score)" in copy.
maya: new control idea: in the compact row, allow a single-key toggle (press "m") to mute/unmute when the run panel has focus. show a tiny undo toast "Test muted — undo".
noah: keep keyboard context-sensitive. global keys are danger. also include a visible focus ring on the compact row for keyboard users.
ara: ARIA live for the toast too: "Test currency-format muted, undo" with role=status. include a short delay before auto-dismiss.
karin: question about weight display: do we show decimals? designers often want to see "1.0" vs just "1" so it's clear it's a number.
maya: show a compact format: omit .0 (show "1") but show decimals when present ("1.25"). hover expands to "weight: 1.25 (contributes 12% to score)".
sam: approval flow impact: if a high-weight test flips, there should be a highlight on the scorecard and a brief explanation line: "High-impact test 'currency-format' failed; score decreased 6 points". that should live in the run header.
karin: also add an optional "blame" tag for tests that are owned by a team — tiny owner pill in the compact row. helps route triage.
maya: implementation notes: keep collapsed rows to one line; use CSS truncation for long test names; clicking expands full diff. add an expand-all / collapse-all toolbar button.
noah: telemetry plan: events: compact_row_click, mute_toggled, weight_hover, badge_tooltip_view, expand_all. track owner_click to see if blame tags are useful.
ara: accessibility checklist I'll hand off: aria-labels for collapsed rows, role=status for toasts, keyboard focus order, contrast ratio for badges, screen-reader friendly summaries for scorecard changes.
sam: product acceptance criteria:
- compact one-line summary showing status, weight, flaky/owner badges
- keyboard toggle (m) for mute when run panel focused, with undo toast aria-live
- decimals shown only when non-integer; hover detail for contribution percent
- consistent copy: "Mute test (ignored from score)" everywhere
- high-impact failure banner in run header when score drops > threshold due to weighted tests
- telemetry events as listed

maya: i'll drop updated mockups into figma and label states: collapsed, expanded, mute-confirm, high-impact banner. figma: figma.com/file/compact-summary-xyz
karin: i'll coordinate with docs to add a short blurb about weights and mute semantics in the eval-run docs.
noah: i'll add the backend flag for flaky computation and expose owner tag in the run payload.
ara: i'll review the new mock and send a small a11y checklist PR.
sam: great — i'll queue this for review in sprint planning. thanks team :thumbsup:
